_about: Classification rules per commodity. 'scale' says which reflectance the thresholds were tuned on: 'legacy' = v1's raw DN/10000, which still carried Sentinel-2's +1000 offset (processing baseline 04.00+, i.e. every scene since January 2022); 'true' = surface reflectance with the offset removed. min_object_px drops specks smaller than that many 10 m pixels; fill_holes_px fills gaps inside a pile up to that size.
